name: glimmervoid-visions

glimmervoidVisions.relayPath.description: Absolute path to the visions relay (dist/session/visions-relay.js in an installed package, session/visions-relay.ts in a source checkout). Empty uses the path stamped at install time.

glimmervoidVisions.port.description: Relay port. Use 0 to let the relay choose its fallback.

description: Mirrors markdown buffers to the Glimmervoid daemon and shows its findings and silent fixes.
